name: The small field, runway 09/27
summary: The test field's general aviation strip for the Cessna and the light twin, south of the middle. The island's runway size, left-hand traffic at 1,000 ft, landed on westward (27).

sources.place: South of the middle at z +13 km (lane/testfield step 0), east-west so each end's circuit and final lie over the map.
